# A natural-request workflow, with fictional Rowan

All people, places, statements and events in this fixture were invented for testing. This is the output of a staged agent conversation, not a real person's records or a new-owner template.

[Read Rowan’s vault](vault/README.md) · [Read the edited local sharing draft](reading-copy/README.md) · [Evaluation and limitations](../../../docs/skills-evaluation.md)

## Requests that drove the work

The first request was “Help me start a rabbit hole. I'd like to talk about the first time I moved home.” The private folder, language and saving scope were already supplied. The agent asked two questions, received fictional answers, and finished after “That's enough for today.” No request to write a story, create links or update indexes was supplied. The exact questions and answers are in the [interview source](vault/80_Sources/Interviews/2019-first-move.md).

Later requests added [three selected posts](selected-posts.json), corrected dates through a new [owner statement](vault/80_Sources/Interviews/2019-dates-correction.md), requested an unsaved conversation and a read-only check, then asked for a local draft for an older sister with the phone calls omitted and Kit described as “a school friend.” The unsaved exchange is not included. The reading copy remains a draft for review, not a record of delivery or privacy clearance.

Independent readers checked the actual narratives and source passages. This snapshot includes the subsequent correction of eighteen source fragments to the proper block-link syntax and minor sharing-copy context/attribution edits. The report distinguishes original results, repairs and replay coverage.

## What is included

- `vault/`: fourteen Markdown notes plus three helper-state files. The configuration, ledger and retained raw input are safe to include here only because every byte is synthetic. They are not suitable inclusions in a real sharing copy.
- `selected-posts.json`: the exact permitted input used by the importer. Its retained copy and hashes can be checked against the ledger.
- `reading-copy/`: only the three selected Markdown files, using ordinary heading links. It omits the master’s state, original sources, maintenance and excluded passages.

Use an Obsidian-compatible reader for the master’s Wiki links and `#^block-id` targets. Its rendered behavior was not tested in native Obsidian; review here used full files, actual anchor definitions and the checker. For import experiments, copy the fictional master outside this Git checkout before using the helper. The helper intentionally refuses write operations inside Git repositories.
